answer:
You cannot refund $150.00 yourself because your limit is $100.00, so the request will be sent to someone with a higher limit for approval.

*   According to "Refund policy", support agents may refund up to $100, team leads approve up to $500, and amounts above $500 require the head of support.
*   If a refund exceeds your limit, Sinew sends it to the appropriate person for approval.
*   "Refund policy" states that once a refund is agreed, it must be issued within 3 working days; if that date is missed, you must apologize, issue the refund the same day, and provide a 10% voucher.
*   Damaged or wrong items can be returned within 30 days, with refunds issued upon warehouse receipt or immediately for items under $40.

Refund policy, "Who can approve a refund": Support agents may refund up to $100. Team leads approve up to $500. Anything above $500 goes to the head of support. If a refund is over your limit, Sinew sends it to the right person for approval.
Refund policy, "Returns": Damaged or wrong items can be returned within 30 days. The refund is issued once the return is received at the warehouse, or straight away for items under $40.
